brief: Combine the two existing illustrations into one explanatory interactive section, with clear click cues and a consistent visual system.

plan.type: Existing Open Sans headings and controls, Arial reading text
plan.layout: One heading and instruction; two equally scaled circular illustrations side by side, stacked on mobile; topic explanations open on demand.
plan.principle: Illustrated points are the navigation. Avoid repeating long text sections or introducing another category/tab bar.

review: The previous repeated explanatory columns were removed. Matching circular outlines and shared plus controls make the figures belong to one system. Instruction explicitly explains how to open information; all labelled controls have accessible names and native button behavior.

interaction.reading: Existing approved paragraphs and sources moved into a native dialog; related product remains available there.
interaction.navigation: Previous/next topics, close button, Escape and backdrop dismissal. Focus returns to the originating button.
interaction.productHandoff: Closes scientific dialog before opening existing product details; exactly one dialog remains open.
interaction.motion: Shared pause control, paused while explanation is open, reduced-motion support.

assets: Existing native SVG microbiota and organ artwork adapted without image generation or changes to original product images.
validation: All topic controls open matching explanations

latestRevision.heading: Explore a ciência do seu cuidado.
latestRevision.subtitle: Descubra como tudo se relaciona clicando nos símbolos para abrir as explicações.
latestRevision.controls: Six separated topic controls below the illustrations, with no topic box overlapping a drawing. Pause button removed; reduced-motion support retained.
latestRevision.classification: General cell illustration opens microbiota overview, not probiotic classification. Shape alone does not identify probiotic status; prebiotics are nonliving substrates; synbiotics are combinations with demonstrated health benefit.
latestRevision.validation: Production build; 320px no overflow, all six controls fully visible and outside artwork; microbiota overview and prebiotic dialog checked.

centralLayoutRevision.layout: Three columns of two compact cards between two illustrations. Row one: prebiotics, probiotics, synbiotics; row two: nerves, metabolites, immunity. The rows are conceptual families, not a claim of one-to-one biological relationships.
centralLayoutRevision.visual: Shared DishFrame component with exactly matching green fill and circular contours. Bare brain and intestine symbols, no bubble surfaces or visible organ labels. Bidirectional animated paths connect them.
centralLayoutRevision.responsive: Desktop has three zones; mobile stacks microbiota, all six cards in 3x2, then gut-brain illustration.
validation: 1100px grid has three equal columns and two equal rows
320px and 820px no horizontal or card text overflow
Brain overview and metabolite explanation open correctly

balanceRevision.layout: Larger central cards (up to 470px overall, 102px high, 14px labels); smaller illustrations capped at 280px.
balanceRevision.illustration: Two uninterrupted cubic curves, related by a 180-degree rotation, replace the joined paths. Brain drawing uses two mirrored filled hemispheres and internal folds; neural branches, molecular forms and three small intestinal microbial forms bring visual detail closer to the microbiota artwork.
balanceRevision.validation: Build passed. 1100px cards measured about149px wide versus107px before; artwork about258px wide. 320px no horizontal or card text overflow. Brain overview and synbiotic explanation opened correctly.
